title: Attended by the very BEST!
text:
We enjoyed Marc's knowledge and enthusiasm so much on our previous tour, we asked if he was available for a drive to tour Montserrat the next day. Because it was such short notice, he had to make some phone calls and make special arrangements to accommodate our request- But he got it done! Montserrat is a truly powerful and humbling place and features some magnificent views of the valley below.
After Montserrat, we went to newer winery and learned a whole different grape growth and bottling philosophy than our first winery... along with another tasting, of course :-)

title: A Perfect day in Montserrat and Penedes Wine Country
text:
Barcelona by Road put together a wonderful day trip for four to Montserrat and Penedes wine country.   First was the Monastery of Montserrat for a private tour and guided hike, then we were treated to a curated tasting lunch at one of the best Penedes wineries followed by a tasting of Cava at one of the area's best cava makers.  It was an absolutely beautiful day.  

Marc's experience and relationships with local wineries and experts meant that the tours were extremely well-curated, bespoke experiences.  Would gladly continue to use Barcelona by Road when touring the area.  Five stars.
author: glindgren

title: A glorious day!
text: My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed our trip to Montserrat and the tapas and wine tasting.  Marc was our guide and he was excellent.  The views from Montserrat are spectacular & worth the trip up the mountain (the roads are great). Marc's enthusiasm and friendliness as well as the perfect weather made the day one of our best in Spain.  If you are traveling in Barcelona and want a terrific experience with a wonderful guide, good food and delicious wine, this should definitely be in your itinerary.
author: camerica1st
